algebraic_realization.kondo_identification: This is the unique graph reflection fixing 15 curve walls, hence Kondo's middle-horizontal reflection tau_2 in Section 4.4.
algebraic_realization.nonsymplectic_torelli_obstruction: For an involution on a K3 with exactly this NS, a nonsymplectic action must be -identity on T. It is therefore trivial on the 2-elementary discriminant, whereas tau_2 swaps two nonzero discriminant classes. The actions cannot glue in the K3 lattice.
algebraic_realization.special_period_scope: This excludes an order-two surface automorphism for every K3 with exactly this Neron-Severi lattice. It does not classify possible higher-order special-period automorphisms inducing the same order-two action on NS; such an action would not realize the proposed involution quotient.
algebraic_realization.symplectic_obstruction: Kondo observes that tau_2 preserves 15 rational curves; a symplectic K3 involution has only eight fixed points.

conclusion.status: Exact rediscovery of Vinberg's published H14 chamber through a non-realizable symmetry of the K3 curve graph.
